scenicChapters.title: Hanno fuel gate → Okutama lake road
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 39 km. 430 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Okutama lake road → Kazahari pass road
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.9%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.

scenicChapters.title: Kazahari pass road → Akiruno food stop
scenicChapters.narrative: 40 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

tokyo-kanto-rides-myogi-mountain-and-kar.story: A one-way ride of 630 km, Hachiōji to Kokubunji - roughly 12 h 07 in the saddle. On the way it passes near Miura, Tokyo / Kanto rides and near Mitsukaidō. The climbs: near Uenohara and Kazahari pass road. It tops out at about 1,150 m.
